discovery_expansion: ore logistics and port inventory systems

primary_sources.title: NBS China industrial production, October 2026
primary_sources.finding: Industrial value added +4.8% y/y; high-tech manufacturing +17.6%; ferrous-metal output weaker.

primary_sources.title: China Mining Association / GACC iron-ore imports
primary_sources.finding: Iron-ore imports +3.1% Jan–Oct while steel output contracts; inventory bridge remains unresolved.

primary_sources.title: SteelHome China port inventory survey
primary_sources.finding: Port stocks 157.36 Mt, +1.16 Mt w/w; trader-held stocks are an estimate, not a full official census.

primary_sources.title: World Steel Association September production
primary_sources.finding: Global crude-steel output down 0.7% Jan–Sep; regional dispersion persists.

primary_sources.title: MDIC Comex Stat
primary_sources.finding: Brazilian NCM 2601 export volume and unit value lower in October; product-level extraction is reproducible.

primary_sources.title: Pilbara Ports October shipping figures
primary_sources.finding: Port Hedland iron-ore exports down 4% y/y in October.

primary_sources.title: Rio Tinto / SimFer Simandou progress
primary_sources.finding: 2.2 Mt shipped in H1; mine and port remain short of full completion.

primary_sources.title: Government of Guinea — Simandou 2040
primary_sources.finding: Sovereign-fund law ratification process reviewed; no completed capitalization or operation confirmed.

primary_sources.title: International Energy Agency Oil Market Report — November 2026
primary_sources.finding: Crude supply has recovered, but refined-product stocks, diesel and freight remain constrained.

primary_sources.title: ECB Financial Stability Review — November 2026
primary_sources.finding: Non-bank leverage, sovereign funding and liquidity mismatch are relevant financing constraints; no project-level financing data.

primary_sources.title: Central Bank of Brazil fiscal statistics
primary_sources.finding: High interest burden and debt stock constrain fiscal room; no direct new project-finance commitment.

primary_sources.title: WOAH ANIMUSE Global Report — 2024 data
primary_sources.finding: Only five of 119 quantitative participants used farm records; diagnostic and data infrastructure gap is measurable, but no procurement or funding pipeline is established.

primary_sources.title: WHO TrACSS 2026
primary_sources.finding: Only 36% report reference-laboratory capacity and 22% funded, fully implemented national plans.

primary_sources.title: ECDC/WHO Europe AMR surveillance 2025 data
primary_sources.finding: Resistance in invasive isolates remains high; surveillance and laboratory capacity are institutional constraints.

primary_sources.title: Anvisa PARA 2026 sampling plan
primary_sources.finding: 3,613 food samples scheduled; no results available before the sampling period closes.

hypotheses.title: Port inventory, blending and grade-management services in the China ore corridor
hypotheses.mechanism: A sustained gap between ore inflows and steel output may increase demand for storage, blending, stock visibility, quality assurance and working-capital services across ports and traders.
evidence: SteelHome monitored port stocks +1.16 Mt w/w
hypotheses.decision: not promoted; no validated buyer, procurement, project economics or durable bottleneck established

hypotheses.title: Simandou rail-port supplier, maintenance and workforce ecosystem
hypotheses.mechanism: The transition from first shipments to full port commissioning may create demand for maintenance, rolling stock, port equipment, inspection, training and local industrial suppliers.
evidence: Railway reported fully commissioned in Q1
Mine 77% and port 85% complete in company disclosure
Guinean government reviewed sovereign-fund ratification process
missing_evidence: Completed ratification, fund capitalization and governance rules
hypotheses.decision: not promoted; construction milestones and policy discussion do not establish an investable supplier opportunity

hypotheses.title: Brazilian iron-ore value-chain adaptation to lower realized export prices
hypotheses.mechanism: Lower unit values and volumes may change the economics of beneficiation, logistics optimization, product quality and capital allocation by exporters.
hypotheses.decision: not promoted; price and volume pressure alone do not identify a viable project or structural bottleneck

hypotheses.title: Veterinary diagnostics and farm-level antimicrobial-use records
hypotheses.mechanism: The gap between national AMR plans and laboratory capacity, together with the low share of farm-record reporting, may create demand for diagnostic networks, veterinary data systems and traceability.
evidence: WOAH ANIMUSE: five of 119 quantitative participants used farm records
ECDC/WHO Europe: persistent resistance in invasive isolates
hypotheses.decision: not promoted; policy need is established, but a funded procurement or operating opportunity is not

hypotheses.title: Industrial energy and refined-product logistics as a cost bottleneck
hypotheses.mechanism: Diesel, freight and refined-product constraints may keep delivered industrial energy costs high even when crude benchmarks ease.
evidence: IEA November report: crude supply recovery alongside low on-land stocks and elevated diesel prices
Mining and steel remain energy- and logistics-intensive
hypotheses.decision: not promoted; broad macro risk is not a project-level opportunity

screening_result.candidate_threshold: No candidate promoted without a named buyer or public procurement, committed financing, measurable operating bottleneck, evidence of utilization or project execution, and a defensible economic mechanism.
screening_result.result: Five research hypotheses retained for follow-up; zero new candidates.

limitations: The iron-ore and steel mismatch is a market signal, not proof of a durable shortage or surplus.
Simandou project milestones are company-reported; port completion, financing drawdowns and local supplier contracts are not yet independently established.
The Guinea sovereign-fund ratification process is not proof of an operational fund.
AMR laboratory and farm-record gaps indicate policy need, not a confirmed procurement opportunity.
No new project-level financing close, utilization series, procurement award or completed commissioning was found for the hypotheses.
